title.narrative: Apoyo al Fortalecimiento Institucional y Operacional del Sector Energtico
Support to the Institutional and Operational Strengthening of the Energy Sector

description.narrative: El objetivo de este marco es organizar el sector y configurar las condiciones para su sostenibilidad en trminos econmicos, financieros y ambientales y, para lograr esta meta, el Gobierno de Suriname decidi centrarse en la reforma del sector de la energa con apoyo del BID. El objetivo de esta primera operacin es brindar apoyo al Gobierno de Suriname para dar inicio al proceso de formulacin de polticas y legislacin. Este proceso luego se consolidar e implementar a travs de compromisos de reforma que se plasmarn en virtud de las operaciones posteriores. Las metas de poltica especficas para cada uno de los componentes del programa se definen en la Matriz de Poltica.

The objective of this framework is to organize the sector, and shape the conditions for its sustainability in economic, financial and environmental terms and in order to achieve this goal the GoS decided to focus on the reform of the power sector with support from the IDB. The purpose of this first operation is to support the GoS in commencing the process of policy and legislation formulation. This process will then be consolidated and implemented, through reform commitments, to be pursued in the subsequent operations. The specific policy goals for each of the components of the Program are defined in the Policy Matrix.
Commitment in 2012-11-20
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2012
